recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not re-add SCH-7 to Appointment.reason unless PA reopens the broader Appointment v2 reason/type/serviceType alignment.
issue_request: FHIR-7875 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for the DSTU1 Appointment resource asking to add SCH-7 to the HL7 v2 mapping for Appointment.reason, which at the time mapped to AIS-3 and ARQ-7.
initial_application: Historical commit 37df64fa17b64de29b79604b4f286c99fb1af124 applied Tracker# 7875 to the old Appointment spreadsheet source by changing Appointment.reason's v2 mapping from AIS-3, ARQ-7 to AIS-3, ARQ-7, SCH-7. The Appointment source was later converted to source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml, and Appointment remains active in source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: FHIR-8843 later removed ARQ-7 from Appointment.reason; FHIR-13861 later removed SCH-7 from Appointment.reason and mapped ARQ-7/SCH-7 to Appointment.appointmentType while adding ARQ-8/SCH-8 to Appointment.serviceType; FHIR-41607 later removed the core appointmentType ARQ-7/SCH-7 mapping and placed ARQ-7/SCH-7 with Appointment.serviceType with a trading-partner review note. FHIR-8843 and FHIR-13861 already have no-change audit commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Appointment source maps Appointment.reason only to AIS-3 and maps ARQ-7/SCH-7 under Appointment.serviceType per the later FHIR-41607 decision, so re-adding SCH-7 to Appointment.reason would be incorrect.
